messages.subject: determining residency status using ctmm
parts:
I remember hearing this summer that the ctmm package was getting an update that would include the ability to determine exactly when an individual went from being a range resident to transient. 

My goal is to determine the residency status (ie. resident or transient) of a group of VHF-collared coyotes. We're looking at over 400+ individuals with some collared across multiple years so looking at each variogram isn't the most efficient tool. Is there a tool or plans to be a tool where we can determine the exact period of time in which an individual made a large shift outside its home range and didn't come back? Maybe something like outlie???

Thanks in advance!
